text: Can import notes from Notion via a dedicated Importer plugin, converting to Markdown
quote: Obsidian lets you easily migrate your data from Notion using the Importer plugin. This converts your Notion workspace to durable Markdown files

text: Notion import preserves databases and formulas by converting them into Bases
quote: Notion account (recommended) connects directly to your workspace and lets you preserve Databases and formulas which are converted to Bases.

text: Can import notes from Airtable, Microsoft OneNote, and Evernote
quote: Import from Notion|Notion - Import from Airtable|Airtable - Import from Microsoft OneNote|Microsoft OneNote - Import from Evernote|Evernote

text: Notes are stored as local, non-proprietary plain-text Markdown files giving full data control and offline use
quote: Obsidian uses non-proprietary plain text Markdown files stored locally on your device. You have total control over your data, which means you can use Obsidian offline and switch to another app easily

text: Vault notes are stored as Markdown-formatted plain text files
quote: Obsidian stores your notes as Markdown-formatted plain text files in a vault.

text: Graph view core plugin visualizes relationships between notes in a vault
quote: Graph view is a core plugin that lets you visualize the relationships between the notes in your vault.

text: Daily notes core plugin opens or creates a note based on today's date
quote: Daily notes is a core plugin that opens a note based on today's date, or creates it if it doesn't exist.

text: Templates core plugin inserts pre-defined text snippets into notes
quote: Templates is a core plugin that lets you insert pre-defined snippets of text into your active note.

text: Bases core plugin creates database-like views of notes
quote: Bases is a core plugin that lets you create database-like views of your notes.

text: Plugins can be used to add support for additional file formats or third-party service integrations
quote: Use plugins to adapt Obsidian to fit your specific needs, such as support for additional file formats or integrating with a third-party service.

text: Custom Obsidian URI protocol lets external tools trigger actions like opening or creating notes
quote: Obsidian URI is a custom URI protocol supported by Obsidian that lets you trigger various actions, such as opening a note or creating a note.

text: Obsidian Sync encrypts the remote vault and all communication with Obsidian's servers
quote: Obsidian Sync encrypts your remote vault and all communication with Obsidian's servers.

text: Obsidian Sync offers a headless client to sync vaults without the desktop app, for CI pipelines and agents
quote: Obsidian Sync offers a headless client to sync vaults without using the desktop app. Useful for CI pipelines, agents, and automated workflows.

text: Obsidian Sync allows collaborating on a shared vault with a team
quote: With Obsidian Sync you can collaborate on a shared vault with your team.

text: Obsidian Publish is a cloud hosting service to publish notes as a wiki, knowledge base, or digital garden
quote: Obsidian Publish is a cloud-based hosting service that lets you publish your notes as a wiki, knowledge base, documentation, or digital garden.

text: Publishing selects notes and hosts them at a publish.obsidian.md site with one click
quote: Select the notes you want to share with the world, press Publish, and we'll host it at publish.obsidian.md/your-site

text: Web Clipper browser extension saves highlighted web content into the vault
quote: Obsidian Web Clipper is a free browser extension that lets you highlight pages and save web content to your vault.

text: Mobile toolbar provides a customizable row of icons for editing notes on mobile
quote: Mobile toolbar is a customization toolbar for editing notes. When editing a note, you will notice a row of icons at the bottom of the app.

text: Developers can compile a sample plugin from source and load it into Obsidian
quote: In this tutorial, you'll compile a sample plugin from source code and load it into Obsidian.

text: Plugins can be built to extend Obsidian's functionality using TypeScript
quote: Build plugins to extend the existing functionality in Obsidian using TypeScript.

text: Vault interface lets code interact with files and folders in the vault, enabling plugin development
quote: Vault, the interface that lets you interact with files and folders in the vault.

text: Themes and snippets can be designed for Obsidian using CSS
quote: Design beautiful themes and snippets for Obsidian using CSS.

text: Linking notes together creates a network of knowledge (bidirectional links)
quote: By linking notes, you can create a network of knowledge.

text: Vault can sync via Dropbox, iCloud, OneDrive, Git, and other third-party services besides Obsidian Sync
quote: Obsidian syncs with Obsidian Sync, Dropbox, iCloud, OneDrive, Git, and many other third-party services.

text: End-to-end encryption is the default sync mode, so not even the Obsidian team can access notes
quote: End-to-end encryption (default) offers the strongest security... This guarantees that no one — not even the Obsidian team — can access your notes.

text: Restricted Mode is on by default to prevent third-party code execution from plugins
quote: By default, Obsidian runs in Restricted Mode to prevent third-party code execution.

text: Version history lets users view or restore previous versions of a note
quote: Version history - View or restore previous versions of a note.

text: Community plugin ecosystem lets users extend Obsidian with community-built plugins
quote: Learn how to extend Obsidian with plugins built by the community.

text: Obsidian Sync is an add-on service to privately sync notes across devices
quote: Obsidian Sync is an add-on service that allows you to privately sync your notes across devices.

text: Plugins let users extend Obsidian with custom features for a tailored note-taking experience
quote: Plugins let you extend Obsidian with your own features to create a custom note-taking experience.
